steps.name: Open closed-for-season op
steps.do: Select **Set restaurant as closed for the season**.
steps.expect: The form opens with **Restaurant**, **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason**.

steps.name: Submit with blank reason
steps.do: Select **Africa Restaurant**. Leave **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason** blank. Click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Africa Restaurant** was set as closed for the season.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Restaurants**. Leave **Include closed restaurants** unchecked.

steps.name: Season message
steps.do: Enable **Include closed restaurants** and click **Africa Restaurant**.
steps.expect: **Africa Restaurant** appears with a light winter-blue background. The popup is blue with a snowflake, the same as an animal off display for the season, and reads **The Africa Restaurant is closed for the season.**

steps.name: Open-for-season lists season only
steps.do: In Console, open **Set restaurant as open for the season** and expand **Restaurant**.
steps.expect: **Africa Restaurant** is listed. The form has no start date or last day. A restaurant that is only temporarily closed is not listed.

steps.name: Submit open for season
steps.expect: Success that **Africa Restaurant** was set as open for the season.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Restaurants** enabled and **Include closed restaurants** unchecked.
steps.expect: **Africa Restaurant** shows as a normal open restaurant again.
